trigger: post-merge on main or explicit workflow_dispatch only
source_rule: Acquire exact published SD01/SD02/SD03 XLSX bytes only from the frozen publisher or official archival sources. Execution 03 prefers EMBL-EBI BioStudies accession S-EPMC5293111, whose S-EPMC collection is populated by supplementary data imported from Europe PMC. Europe PMC supplementaryFiles and frozen publisher/NCBI direct paths remain failovers. Never substitute a third-party processed mirror.
source_change_scope: Execution 03 changes acquisition transport authority only. Thresholds, folds, baseline weights, assay normalization, label firewall, selection budgets, primary endpoints, and scientific verdict rules are unchanged.
label_firewall: SD01 worksheet cells may not be opened until the persisted assay-preflight receipt is reloaded and its assay_only_sha256 is verified against the persisted assay-only artifact.
raw_xlsx_commit_policy: never commit raw publisher or archival XLSX files
result_mutation_policy: A completed result is immutable evidence for its execution. Any later code, source, threshold, policy, or outcome-rule change requires another prospective execution identifier.
